title: Size of the informal economy
description_plain: Marginal insight into the informal economy, limiting accurate taxpayer identification and tax-liability calculation.

title: Weak motivation for voluntary compliance
description_plain: Taxpayer trust gaps driven by perceived inconsistency, weak transparency and uneven treatment, undermining willingness to pay taxes.

title: Inadequate digital technology adoption
description_plain: Limited use of integrated data and analytics to identify risk, address non-compliance and widen the tax base.

title: ICT performance, incomplete digitalisation & poor data integration
description_plain: Reliance on manual/semi-automated processes, system instability, ageing infrastructure, and fragmented, poorly integrated systems.

title: Organisational design and capacity gaps
description_plain: Capacity and skills gaps in strategic planning, project execution, change management, procurement, investigations, ICT and HR.

title: Compliance, governance and accountability
description_plain: Low voluntary compliance, a narrowing tax base, and delayed implementation of audit recommendations and recurring governance gaps.

title: Risk management, cybersecurity and institutional integrity
description_plain: Rising cybersecurity exposure, ineffective internal communication and weak leadership engagement on integrity issues.

title: Improve external stakeholder engagement quality
description_plain: Improve taxpayer perception of fairness and transparency, offer simple self-service digital tools, and boost partner and development-partner confidence.

title: Improve insight into the informal economy and taxpayers
description_plain: Better understand the informal economy, taxpayer needs, behaviours and risks, and expand access to third-party data across government and private institutions.
